theme: Light theme dominant (warm cream/off-white) with deep forest green sections for contrast. Apple x Scandinavian minimalism x luxury healthcare.

fonts.headings: Cormorant Garamond, serif (Luxury, elegant, trustworthy, editorial feel)
fonts.body: Manrope, sans-serif (Clean, readable, modern geometric sans)

hierarchy.h1: text-5xl sm:text-6xl lg:text-7xl font-light tracking-tight text-forest-900

rules: NEVER use Inter, Space Grotesk, or generic defaults.
Headings must use Cormorant Garamond with tight letter spacing (tracking-tight) to feel editorial.
Never center align body text; prefer left alignment for readability.
Line height must be tight for headings (leading-none or leading-tight) and loose for body (leading-relaxed).
Deep forest green is the anchor. Warm cream is the canvas.
Avoid harsh pure white (#FFFFFF) for the main background; use warm cream (#F9F6F0) to reduce clinical anxiety.
No generic full-screen gradients. Use solid colors or very subtle radial glows.
Ensure text contrast meets APCA/WCAG standards (minimum 4.5:1 for body).

surfaces: Cards: Flat solid surfaces with subtle 1px borders (border-forest-100) and soft ambient shadows.

Glassmorphism (Crystal Variant): Use ONLY for the sticky nav or AI Symptom Checker floating UI. Implement with backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70 or bg-forest-900/80 and 1px inner border. Never use muddy gray transparency.
Corner Radius: Subtle roundness (rounded-2xl to rounded-3xl for cards). Nothing sharp, nothing too bubbly.
visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle noise/grain overlay globally on dark sections to make it feel like premium print, not digital flat.

grids_and_layouts.spacing_system: Generous spacing. Use p-12, p-16, p-24, py-32 to create breathing room. Do not cram elements.

patterns.hero: Asymmetric split layout. Left side: Text and CTAs. Right side: Doctor's photo spanning height.
patterns.trust_bar: Marquee or wide horizontal grid, muted opacity for logos, extremely clean.
patterns.cards_grid: Bento style or 3-column grid with gap-8. Elements must be direct children of the grid.
patterns.patient_journey: Vertical timeline with a scrolling progress line connecting steps.

interactions: Lenis: Must be used for smooth momentum scrolling.
Framer Motion: Scroll-triggered fade-ups (y: 30, opacity: 0 -> y: 0, opacity: 1) with easeOut.
Hover states: Subtle lifts (-translate-y-1) and shadow increases on cards.
AI Typing Effect: For the symptom checker responses to mimic human interaction.

images.description: Doctor in white coat at American Hospital. Use as primary hero image.
Doctor profile headshot. Use in the 'About Dr. Meisam' section.
Minimalist bright hallway. Use as background for trust or testimonial sections.
Calm Scandinavian nature landscape. Use as a parallax background or texture for the 'Why Choose' or Swedish Board Certified section.
Clean 3D anatomical layout. Use as subtle visual for the 'Conditions' section.

rules: Images must be object-cover and bounded. Max height 80vh on mobile.
If text overlays an image, use a gradient scrim (bg-gradient-to-t from-forest-900/80 to-transparent) or glassmorphism. NEVER pure transparent.

component_guidelines.navigation: Sticky (top-0, z-50). Crystal glassmorphism. Left: Logo, Middle: Desktop links, Right: Language Switcher (EN/AR/SV) + Primary CTA.
component_guidelines.buttons: Pill-shaped (rounded-full). Primary: bg-forest-900 text-white hover:bg-forest-800. Secondary: border border-forest-900 text-forest-900 hover:bg-forest-100.
component_guidelines.symptom_checker: Interactive UI. A container with symptom chips ('Hernia', 'Reflux'). Clicking a chip triggers a framer-motion card appearing with an AI-generated surgeon's response. Needs 'AI Typing' simulation.
component_guidelines.condition_cards: Expandable Shadcn/framer-motion accordion or cards. Must have ample p-8 padding and elegant typography.

accessibility.contrast: Strict APCA/WCAG standards. Text on dark green must be white/cream.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements (buttons, chips, language toggle, accordion) MUST have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='book-consultation-btn').

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You are building a luxury healthcare site, not a SaaS dashboard. Avoid generic Inter font, avoid standard blue gradients.
Use framer-motion heavily but tastefully—fade ups, slow transitions. Static is dead.
Padding must be luxurious. Use p-12 to py-32 for sections.
The AI Symptom Checker must feel personal. Use a subtle animation for the AI typing.
Do not use generic placeholder texts. Write realistic copy based on the prompt (Clear answers. Precise surgery. Personal care.).
Links like 'Book Consultation' should href to 'tel:+97143775500' or WhatsApp 'https://wa.me/97143775500'. No basic forms.
Use lucide-react or @phosphor-icons/react for premium, thin icons.
Build using .js files since the project uses JS.
